senses.en: an area of a town or country

ex.en: Our school is in the old district.
ex.zh: 我们学校在老城区。

ex.en: A poor district can have excellent students and still lack a clinic within walking distance.
ex.zh: 一个较穷的区可以有优秀的学生，却仍然没有步行能到的诊所。

tip: district 是可数名词。

senses.en: to be unlike
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: Opinions may differ among friends.
ex.zh: 朋友之间意见可能不同。

ex.en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
ex.zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。

col: differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

senses.en: brightness, or a lamp
not heavy, or bright, or pale
to start something burning

ex.en: Please turn off the light when you leave.
ex.zh: 离开时请关灯。

ex.en: Street light makes the walk home safer, but too much light can also hide the night sky.
ex.zh: 路灯让回家的路更安全，但过多的光也会遮住夜空。

tip: light 作形容词是“轻的”或“浅色的”，比较级 lighter。作动词“点燃”的过去式可以是 lit。

senses.en: not detailed; overall
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: In general, people prefer weekends.
ex.zh: 一般来说，人们更喜欢周末。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: to say someone is responsible for a fault
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame others for your mistakes.
ex.zh: 不要把自己的错误归咎于别人。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

senses.en: for all future time

ex.en: Nothing stays the same forever.
ex.zh: 没有什么会永远不变。

ex.en: A plastic bag lasts forever in a ditch, which is why the canteen stopped giving them out.
ex.zh: 塑料袋在沟里能留很久，所以食堂不再发放。

tip: forever 是副词。for ever 分开写也可以，本库用 forever。

senses.en: to direct one's eyes, or to seem

ex.en: Look at the diagram before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答之前先看图。

ex.en: Streets that look beautiful in photos may still be unsafe if there is nowhere to cross.
ex.zh: 在照片里好看的街道，如果没有地方过马路，仍然可能不安全。

tip: look forward to 后面接名词或 doing。look 是看的动作，see 是看见。

senses.en: costing a lot of money

ex.en: The jacket is too expensive.
ex.zh: 这件外套太贵了。

ex.en: An expensive textbook helps nobody if the library has no copy to borrow.
ex.zh: 如果图书馆没有可借的一本，昂贵的课本就帮不到人。

tip: expensive 的反义词可以是 cheap 或 inexpensive。

senses.en: a system of words used by a group

ex.en: English is not her first language.
ex.zh: 英语不是她的第一语言。

ex.en: A local language disappears faster when children never hear it outside the home.
ex.zh: 当孩子在家门外再也听不到一种本地语言时，它会消失得更快。

tip: language 可数。the English language 要加 the。

senses.en: doing something repeatedly to improve

ex.en: Piano practice is at four.
ex.zh: 钢琴练习在四点。

ex.en: Practice on a real street teaches road safety better than a worksheet.
ex.zh: 在真实的街道上练习，比一张练习纸更能教会交通安全。

tip: 英式里 practice 是名词，practise 是动词；美式动词也拼作 practice。

senses.en: having a lot to do

ex.en: The office is busy on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 办公室周一早上很忙。

ex.en: A busy road beside a school gate needs a crossing, not only a sign that says slow.
ex.zh: 校门口旁边的繁忙道路需要斑马线，而不只是一块写着慢行的牌子。

tip: 人忙用 busy。电话占线也说 The line is busy。

senses.en: to put words on paper or a screen

ex.en: Write your name at the top.
ex.zh: 把名字写在上方。

ex.en: Students write more clearly when they have a quiet place and enough time.
ex.zh: 当学生有安静的地方和足够的时间时，他们写得更清楚。

tip: write 的过去式是 wrote，过去分词是 written。

senses.en: not in good health

ex.en: She is ill and will stay at home.
ex.zh: 她病了，会待在家里。

ex.en: Sending an ill child to a test spreads the illness and does not prove what they know.
ex.zh: 让生病的孩子去考试会传播疾病，也证明不了他们会什么。

tip: ill 作表语。定语常用 sick：a sick child。sick 已在本库。feel ill 和 feel sick 在英式里都常见。

senses.en: a member of a country
A person who lives in a particular town or city.

ex.en: Every citizen has rights and duties.
ex.zh: 每个公民都有权利与义务。

ex.en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

col: a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

senses.en: a hard piece of rock

ex.en: A stone marks the start of the path.
ex.zh: 一块石头标出小路的起点。

ex.en: Children throwing stones near a window turn a game into a repair bill.
ex.zh: 孩子在窗户附近扔石头，会把游戏变成一笔修理费。

tip: stone 可数。作为材料“石料”时常不可数。

senses.en: first in order, or most important

ex.en: Her little brother is still in primary school.
ex.zh: 她弟弟还在上小学。

ex.en: The primary reason for the new bus is safety, and the shorter ride is only a bonus.
ex.zh: 新公交的主要原因是安全，路程变短只是附带的好处。

tip: primary school 是小学。primary 也可表示“首要的”。

senses.en: the moment a baby is born, or a beginning

ex.en: The form asks for your date of birth.
ex.zh: 表格要填写出生日期。

ex.en: A town records every birth so the school knows how many desks it will need.
ex.zh: 城镇登记每一次出生，学校才知道将来需要多少课桌。

tip: birthday 是生日，birth 是出生这件事。本批两条都有。

senses.en: relating to a central government of states

ex.en: The federal museum lent the town an old map.
ex.zh: 联邦博物馆借给这个城镇一张旧地图。

ex.en: Federal money for rural buses matters when a state budget cannot cover the long routes.
ex.zh: 当州预算覆盖不了长线路时，用于乡村公交的联邦资金就很重要。

tip: federal 多用于美国等联邦制国家的中央政府。

senses.en: a common animal kept at home

ex.en: The dog waited outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 狗在教室外面等着。

ex.en: A dog on a loose lead near a school gate can frighten children who are trying to cross.
ex.zh: 校门口松着绳子的狗，会吓到正要过马路的孩子。

tip: dog 是可数名词。

senses.en: the greatest amount allowed
to keep something below a level

ex.en: There is a limit of two bags.
ex.zh: 行李限两件。

ex.en: A speed limit near a school only helps if the sign can be seen in the rain.
ex.zh: 学校附近的限速只有在雨中也能看见标志时才有用。

tip: limit 作动词是限制。a limit to 或 a limit on 都可以。

senses.en: an alcoholic drink made from grapes

ex.en: The recipe says the meat is cooked with wine.
ex.zh: 菜谱说这肉是用葡萄酒烹的。

ex.en: A school event should not treat wine as a prize for teenagers.
ex.zh: 学校活动不应当把葡萄酒当作给青少年的奖品。

col: a glass of wine｜一杯葡萄酒
tip: wine 通常不可数。a wine 可指一种葡萄酒。

senses.en: money owed

ex.en: The club is in debt after the trip.
ex.zh: 出行之后社团欠了债。

ex.en: Student debt is easier to discuss when the school shows the real cost of a year.
ex.zh: 当学校出示一年的真实费用时，学生债务就比较好讨论。

col: pay off a debt｜还清债务
tip: debt 里的 b 不发音。in debt 表示欠债。

senses.en: to speak with someone
a conversation or a speech

ex.en: We talked about the class trip at lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭时我们谈了班级出游。

ex.en: Teachers who talk with students about sleep learn more than they do from a questionnaire alone.
ex.zh: 和学生谈睡眠的老师，比只看问卷了解得更多。

tip: talk 强调交谈；say 强调说出的内容。

senses.en: a mother

ex.en: My mom works at the hospital.
ex.zh: 我妈妈在医院工作。

ex.en: A mom on a night shift may never see the school play her child is in.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妈妈可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。

tip: mom 是美式口语；英式常用 mum。正式写作可用 mother。

senses.en: something kept hidden
hidden

ex.en: Please keep the plan a secret until Friday.
ex.zh: 请把计划保密到周五。

ex.en: A secret about a leaking school roof helps nobody; the town needs to know.
ex.zh: 对漏雨校舍屋顶保密谁也帮不了；城镇需要知道。

tip: secret 作形容词是“秘密的”。

senses.en: to go up, or to stand up
an increase

ex.en: Prices rise when the harvest is poor.
ex.zh: 收成不好时价格上涨。

ex.en: Rivers rise quickly in this valley, so the school keeps boots by the back door.
ex.zh: 这条山谷里河水涨得快，所以学校在后门放着靴子。

tip: rise 是不及物动词。及物的“举起、提高”用 raise。过去式 rose，过去分词 risen。

senses.en: a polite title for a man

ex.en: Yes, sir, I will bring the form tomorrow.
ex.zh: 是的，先生，我明天把表格带来。

ex.en: A letter that begins with Sir still fails if the request itself is unclear.
ex.zh: 以 Sir 开头的信，如果请求本身不清楚，仍然会失败。

tip: sir 单独称呼时不大写也可，但在书信 Dear Sir 中要大写。

senses.en: a room where people do written work

ex.en: The teacher is in the office now.
ex.zh: 老师现在在办公室。

ex.en: An office that stays lit all night wastes power and tells the street that nobody switched it off.
ex.zh: 整夜亮灯的办公室既费电，也向街道表明没人去关灯。

tip: in the office 表示在办公室里。

senses.en: a person you know and like

ex.en: My friend lent me her notes.
ex.zh: 朋友把笔记借给了我。

ex.en: A friend who checks a rumour before sharing it protects the whole class from a false story.
ex.zh: 先核对谣言再转发的朋友，能保护全班不受假消息影响。

col: a friend of mine｜我的一个朋友
tip: make friends with sb 表示与某人交朋友。

senses.en: moving air
to turn or twist something around

ex.en: The wind closed the classroom door.
ex.zh: 风把门带上了。

ex.en: A strong wind along a river path can make a bike ride to school unsafe.
ex.zh: 河边路上的大风，会让骑车上学变得不安全。

tip: 作“风”时读 /wɪnd/。作“缠绕”时读 /waɪnd/，过去式是 wound。

senses.en: certain, or reliable

ex.en: Are you sure this is your bag?
ex.zh: 你确定这是你的包吗？

ex.en: Leaders should not be sure a policy works until they have asked the people who live with it.
ex.zh: 领导者在询问真正生活在政策之下的人之前，不应确信政策有效。

tip: be sure to do 提醒某人一定要做；make sure 后面常接 that 从句。

senses.en: a set of printed pages
to arrange to have something later

ex.en: I borrowed a book from the school library.
ex.zh: 我从学校图书馆借了一本书。

ex.en: A town that closes its bookshop loses a place where people discover titles a screen did not suggest.
ex.zh: 关掉书店的城镇，失去了一个人们发现屏幕不曾推荐的书的地方。

tip: book 作动词是“预订”：book a ticket。

senses.en: the hard material from a tree

ex.en: The gate is made of wood.
ex.zh: 这扇门是木头做的。

ex.en: A path through the wood is pleasant in daylight and hard to follow after dark.
ex.zh: 白天穿过小树林的路很好走，天黑以后就难认了。

col: a piece of wood｜一块木头
tip: wood 作材料不可数。woods 常指小树林。表里这一行的音标是 wonderful，本库不用。

senses.en: not public

ex.en: This is a private letter.
ex.zh: 这是一封私人信件。

ex.en: Private buses may fill a gap, but they often skip the stops that make the least money.
ex.zh: 私人公交也许能补上缺口，但它们常常跳过最不赚钱的站点。

tip: private 与 public 相对。

senses.en: the place where one lives

ex.en: I left my keys at home.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在家里了。

ex.en: A city that offers only expensive flats cannot call itself a home for the nurses and drivers it needs.
ex.zh: 一座只提供昂贵公寓的城市，无法成为它所需的护士和司机的家。

tip: home 前通常不加 to：go home，不是 go to home。

senses.en: money paid to a government

ex.en: The town uses tax money to repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 城镇用税款修桥。

ex.en: A small tax on plastic bags can change what people carry home from the market.
ex.zh: 对塑料袋征收一小笔税，可以改变人们从市场拎回家的东西。

tip: tax 作动词是“征税”。

senses.en: a day of the month, or a planned meeting
to write the day on something

ex.en: Write the date at the top of the page.
ex.zh: 把日期写在页首。

ex.en: The date on a food label matters when a family cannot afford to throw good food away.
ex.zh: 当一个家庭扔不起还好的食物时，食品标签上的日期就很重要。

tip: date 作动词是“注明日期”或“约会”。

senses.en: to close

ex.en: Please shut the window before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前请关上窗户。

ex.en: Shops that shut at dusk leave students who finish late with a longer walk home.
ex.zh: 黄昏就关门的商店，会让下课晚的学生走更远的路回家。

tip: shut 的过去式和过去分词仍是 shut。shut up 语气粗鲁，正式场合不要用。

senses.en: a group of people who meet for an activity

ex.en: I joined the reading club this term.
ex.zh: 这学期我加入了读书社团。

ex.en: A school club that costs money to join leaves out students who cannot pay.
ex.zh: 需要交钱才能加入的学校社团，会把付不起钱的学生排除在外。

tip: club 也可指棍棒，考纲里更常见的是社团。

senses.en: a feeling, a meaning, or a way of noticing

ex.en: There is a sense of quiet in the library.
ex.zh: 图书馆里有一种安静的感觉。

ex.en: A sense of fairness grows when students see that rules apply to everyone.
ex.zh: 当学生看到规则适用于所有人时，公平感会增长。

col: in a sense｜在某种意义上
tip: make sense 表示说得通，主语是事物。

senses.en: the reflexive form of I

ex.en: I made the poster myself.
ex.zh: 海报是我自己做的。

ex.en: I asked myself whether a shorter shower would matter if the whole building still wasted water.
ex.zh: 我问自己，如果整栋楼仍在浪费水，缩短淋浴是否还有意义。

tip: myself 作宾语或同位语，不能替代 I 作主语。

senses.en: before now, or sooner than expected

ex.en: I have already handed in the form.
ex.zh: 我已经交了表格。

ex.en: By the time a warning is issued, the river may already have risen over the path to school.
ex.zh: 等到警报发出时，河水可能已经漫过上学的小路。

tip: already 多用于肯定句；否定和疑问里表示“尚未”常用 yet。

senses.en: to cover a wider area, or to open something out

ex.en: Open windows so the smell does not spread.
ex.zh: 打开窗户，免得气味扩散。

ex.en: Rumours spread faster than corrections, which is why the first notice must be accurate.
ex.zh: 谣言比更正传得快，所以第一则通知必须准确。

tip: spread 的过去式和过去分词仍是 spread。

senses.en: a view, or the place where something happens

ex.en: The first scene of the play is a classroom.
ex.zh: 剧的第一场是一间教室。

ex.en: The scene after a flood is not only mud; it is also the question of who will repair the road.
ex.zh: 洪水之后的场面不只是泥，还有谁来修路的问题。

tip: scene 可指戏剧的一场、景色或事件现场。

senses.en: a substance used to treat illness, or the study of it

ex.en: Take the medicine after food.
ex.zh: 饭后吃药。

ex.en: Modern medicine can treat the infection, and the clinic still has to be open.
ex.zh: 现代医学能治疗这种感染，诊所却仍然得开着门。

tip: medicine 作“药”时常不可数。drug 已在本库，可指药物或毒品，写作时要分清。

senses.en: a win

ex.en: The victory belonged to the whole team.
ex.zh: 胜利属于整支队伍。

ex.en: A victory on the field means less if the bus home is not safe.
ex.zh: 如果回家的车不安全，场上的胜利就没那么重要。

tip: victory 是名词。动词获胜用 win。

senses.en: to hit with the foot

ex.en: Do not kick the ball in the hallway.
ex.zh: 不要在走廊里踢球。

ex.en: A rule against kicking bags under the desk saves both shins and the cleaning staff.
ex.zh: 禁止把包踢到桌下的规定，既保护小腿，也帮了清洁人员。

tip: kick off 可表示比赛开球，也可比喻活动开始。

senses.en: a piece of music with words

ex.en: We learned a new song in music class.
ex.zh: 音乐课上我们学了一首新歌。

ex.en: A local song can keep a dialect alive when children no longer hear it at home.
ex.zh: 当孩子在家里不再听到一种方言时，一首本地歌曲能让它继续活着。

tip: song 是可数名词。

senses.en: a section of a school, shop, or government

ex.en: She works in the English department.
ex.zh: 她在英语系工作。

ex.en: A health department that shares data with schools can warn them before a heatwave arrives.
ex.zh: 与学校共享数据的卫生部门，可以在热浪到来前发出警告。

tip: department 是组织里的部门或大学的系。

senses.en: the point where two lines or streets meet

ex.en: The bookshop is on the corner.
ex.zh: 书店在拐角处。

ex.en: A dark corner near the station feels unsafe even when the crime rate is low.
ex.zh: 车站附近阴暗的角落即使犯罪率很低，也会让人觉得不安全。

col: around the corner｜在附近；即将来临
tip: 房间角落用 in the corner。街道拐角用 on the corner。

senses.en: physical activity, or a piece of work to practise
to do physical activity

ex.en: Morning exercise is in the yard.
ex.zh: 早晨锻炼在院子里。

ex.en: An exercise book full of copies is not the same as one hard problem done slowly.
ex.zh: 一本抄满的练习册，不等于慢慢做完的一道难题。

tip: exercise 作“锻炼”时常不可数；作“习题”时可数。也可作动词。

senses.en: not hard, or not loud or bright

ex.en: The ground is soft after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后地面很软。

ex.en: Soft light in a hallway can save energy and still show the step.
ex.zh: 走廊里柔和的灯可以省电，同时仍然照得见台阶。

tip: soft drink 是不含酒精的饮料。表里没有单独的 soft 音标行，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: an upright side of a room or a barrier

ex.en: The notice is on the wall.
ex.zh: 通知在墙上。

ex.en: A high wall around a school can keep children safe and also hide the street they need to learn.
ex.zh: 学校周围的高墙可以保护孩子，也会挡住他们需要认识的街道。

tip: 在墙上用 on the wall。

senses.en: a weapon that shoots

ex.en: The museum does not allow a gun in the building.
ex.zh: 博物馆不允许把枪带进楼里。

ex.en: A history lesson about a gun should also ask who was harmed, not only how the machine worked.
ex.zh: 关于枪的历史课也应该问谁受到了伤害，而不只是机器如何工作。

tip: gun 是可数名词。

senses.en: to feel that something is important
attention or looking after someone

ex.en: She cares about every student in the class.
ex.zh: 她关心班上的每一个学生。

ex.en: People care more about a park when they helped plant the trees than when they only walk past it.
ex.zh: 人们如果参与种过树，会比只是路过时更在意一座公园。

tip: care for 可以是照顾，也可以是“喜欢”，要看语境。

senses.en: of the colour of gold, or excellent

ex.en: The golden light lasted ten minutes.
ex.zh: 金色的光持续了十分钟。

ex.en: A golden chance to fix the roof comes before the rainy season, not after the first leak.
ex.zh: 修屋顶的黄金机会在雨季之前，而不是第一次漏水之后。

tip: golden 多形容颜色或比喻“极好”。金子本身用 gold。

senses.en: the larger part of a group

ex.en: The majority of students walk or cycle.
ex.zh: 大多数学生步行或骑车。

ex.en: A majority vote can still be unfair if the people most affected were not in the room.
ex.zh: 如果受影响最大的人不在房间里，多数票仍然可能不公平。

tip: the majority of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数。

senses.en: to feel anxious about something
a problem that makes you anxious

ex.en: Do not worry about the result tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚先别为结果担心。

ex.en: Parents worry when the last bus is cancelled and the school has not sent a message.
ex.zh: 末班车取消而学校又没发消息时，家长会担心。

tip: worry 后接 about。形容词 worried 形容人，worrying 形容事情。

senses.en: money gained after costs

ex.en: The book fair made a small profit.
ex.zh: 书展有了一小笔利润。

ex.en: A profit from the canteen should be explained to the students who paid for lunch.
ex.zh: 食堂的利润应当向付钱吃午饭的学生说明。

tip: profit 作动词是获益。profit from something。

senses.en: a large boat

ex.en: The ship left the port at dawn.
ex.zh: 船在黎明离开了港口。

ex.en: Goods on a ship still need a road at the other end if a village is to receive them.
ex.zh: 如果一个村子要收到货物，船上的货在另一头仍然需要一条路。

tip: ship 作动词是“运送”。

senses.en: the part of the body between the shoulder and the hand
to provide with weapons or tools

ex.en: She carried the books in one arm.
ex.zh: 她用一只胳膊抱着书。

ex.en: A chair with no arm is cheaper, and it is harder for some students to stand up from.
ex.zh: 没有扶手的椅子更便宜，有些学生也更难从上面站起来。

tip: arm 作动词是武装。家具的扶手也叫 arm。

senses.en: an adult female person

ex.en: A woman from the clinic spoke to our class.
ex.zh: 诊所的一位女士给我们班讲了话。

ex.en: A woman who works a night shift still needs a safe way home when the last bus has gone.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妇女在末班车走后，仍然需要一条安全的回家路。

tip: woman 的复数是 women，读音也变。

senses.en: coming immediately after

ex.en: The next bus leaves in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 下一班车十分钟后开。

ex.en: The next step after collecting data is to ask whether the sample left anyone out.
ex.zh: 收集数据之后的下一步，是追问样本是否漏掉了什么人。

tip: next week 前不加 the；the next week 常指过去某个时间之后的一周。

senses.en: a medicine, or an illegal substance

ex.en: The drug must stay in the school clinic.
ex.zh: 这种药必须放在校医务室。

ex.en: Health class should say clearly that a drug from a doctor is not the same thing as an illegal drug.
ex.zh: 健康课应当讲清楚：医生开的药和非法毒品不是一回事。

tip: drug 既可以是正规药物，也可以是毒品。写作时要加修饰语，避免含糊。

senses.en: the organisation that keeps public order

ex.en: The police helped the children cross the road.
ex.zh: 警察帮助孩子们过马路。

ex.en: Police cannot be the only answer to a dark street; lights and pavements matter too.
ex.zh: 警察不能是黑暗街道的唯一答案；灯和人行道也很重要。

tip: police 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。一个警察用 a police officer。

senses.en: not old

ex.en: The young trees need water every evening.
ex.zh: 这些小树每天晚上需要浇水。

ex.en: Young workers leave a town when the only jobs are far away and poorly paid.
ex.zh: 当仅有的工作又远又报酬低时，年轻工人会离开城镇。

tip: the young 表示年轻人这一类，谓语用复数。

senses.en: to say numbers in order, or to be important
an act of counting

ex.en: Count the chairs before the parents arrive.
ex.zh: 家长到之前先数椅子。

ex.en: Every voice should count when a class decides how to share one practice room.
ex.zh: 班级决定如何共用一间练习室时，每个声音都应当算数。

tip: count on somebody 表示依靠某人。count 也可作名词“计数”。

senses.en: the facts of a particular time

ex.en: The situation is better than last week.
ex.zh: 情况比上周好。

ex.en: The situation on a flooded street is not the same as the situation on a dry planning map.
ex.zh: 积水街道上的情况，和干燥的规划地图上的情况不一样。

col: in a situation｜处于某种情况
tip: situation 是可数名词。

senses.en: a picture made by a camera

ex.en: She took a photo of the old bridge.
ex.zh: 她给旧桥拍了张照片。

ex.en: A photo of a clean park can hide the street where the rubbish was taken.
ex.zh: 一张干净公园的照片，可以藏起垃圾被运去的那条街。

tip: photo 是 photograph 的简写，复数是 photos。

senses.en: every person

ex.en: Everybody in our class joined the clean-up.
ex.zh: 我们班每个人都参加了打扫。

ex.en: Everybody needs a seat at the meeting if the decision will change their bus home.
ex.zh: 如果决定会改变他们回家的公交，每个人都需要在会上有一个座位。

tip: everybody 后接单数动词。和 everyone 同义，本库两条都保留。不要写成 every body（每一具身体）。

senses.en: to keep doing something

ex.en: Please continue reading after the break.
ex.zh: 休息后请继续阅读。

ex.en: If factories continue to pour waste at night, daytime clean-ups will not save the river.
ex.zh: 如果工厂继续在夜里排污，白天的清理也救不了这条河。

tip: continue 后接 to do 或 doing 都可以。

senses.en: a sports game, or a small stick for making fire
to fit or be equal to

ex.en: The football match is on Saturday.
ex.zh: 足球赛在周六。

ex.en: A cup match brings visitors, but the town still needs bins and buses after the final whistle.
ex.zh: 杯赛带来观众，但终场哨响后城镇仍需要垃圾桶和公交。

col: a box of matches｜一盒火柴
tip: match 作动词是“匹配”。win a match，不说 win sb。

senses.en: the organ that pumps blood, or the centre

ex.en: Regular walks are good for the heart.
ex.zh: 经常走路对心脏有好处。

ex.en: A market in the heart of a town keeps daily life there; a mall on the edge can empty the centre.
ex.zh: 镇中心的市场维持着那里的日常生活；边缘的商场可能掏空中心。

tip: by heart 表示靠记忆，不是“靠心脏”。

senses.en: not wet
to make or become dry

ex.en: Hang the coats where they can dry.
ex.zh: 把外套挂在能晾干的地方。

ex.en: A dry year raises the price of vegetables before it empties the school taps.
ex.zh: 干旱的一年会先抬高菜价，然后才会让学校的水龙头没水。

tip: dry 作动词是使变干。

senses.en: before now

ex.en: The museum closed two years ago.
ex.zh: 博物馆两年前关门了。

ex.en: A factory that shut ten years ago can still leave chemicals in the soil beside a school.
ex.zh: 十年前关闭的工厂，仍可能把化学物质留在学校旁边的土壤里。

tip: ago 用于过去时，放在时间段后面：three days ago。不与现在完成时连用。

senses.en: shaped like a circle
around
one stage of an event

ex.en: They sat at a round table.
ex.zh: 他们坐在圆桌旁。

ex.en: A round of talks about the river should include the farms upstream, not only the city.
ex.zh: 关于这条河的一轮会谈应该包括上游的农场，而不只是城市。

col: all the year round｜一年到头
tip: 英式里 round 常作介词“围绕”；美式多用 around。

senses.en: a male child

ex.en: Her son walks to school with a neighbour.
ex.zh: 她儿子和邻居一起走路上学。

ex.en: A son who leaves for the city may still send money home, but the village loses his daily help.
ex.zh: 去城市的儿子也许仍会寄钱回家，但村子失去了他日常的帮忙。

tip: son 的复数是 sons。

senses.en: personality; a person in a story
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Honesty is part of his character.
ex.zh: 诚实是他性格的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: not one and not the other of two
not either of two

ex.en: Neither answer is fully right.
ex.zh: 两个答案都不完全对。

ex.en: Neither the early bus nor the late one stops at the new housing block.
ex.zh: 早班车和晚班车都不在新建的住宅区停。

tip: neither 作主语时谓语常用单数。nor 已在本库。

senses.en: a special day or period of public celebration

ex.en: The town festival is next weekend.
ex.zh: 镇上的节日在下个周末。

ex.en: A school festival should name which dates belong to which community, and not assume one calendar.
ex.zh: 学校的节日活动应当写明哪些日子属于哪个群体，而不假定只有一种日历。

tip: festival 可数。on the festival 不如 at the festival 或 during the festival 常见。

senses.en: to get something that is given or sent

ex.en: I received your message this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上收到了你的信息。

ex.en: Students who receive help early are less likely to hide a problem until the exam.
ex.zh: 早点得到帮助的学生，不太会把问题藏到考试。

tip: 拼写是 receive：c 后面是 ei。收到并不等于接受，接受用 accept。

senses.en: perhaps

ex.en: Maybe we can meet after the club.
ex.zh: 也许我们可以在社团活动后见面。

ex.en: Maybe a later school start would help, but only if buses change their times too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改时间才行。

tip: maybe 是一个副词；may be 是情态动词加动词，要分开写。

senses.en: a point given for work, or a sign
to write a sign, or to give a score

ex.en: She got a high mark in the reading test.
ex.zh: 她阅读测验得了高分。

ex.en: A single mark on one test should not decide whether a student can join the science club.
ex.zh: 一次测验的一个分数，不该决定学生能否参加科学社团。

tip: mark 作动词是“做标记”或“打分”。

senses.en: the worth or importance of something
to think something is important

ex.en: The old map still has value for the history class.
ex.zh: 这张旧地图对历史课仍有价值。

ex.en: The value of a library is not only the books, but the quiet hour it gives after school.
ex.zh: 图书馆的价值不只是书，还有它在放学后提供的安静一小时。

tip: value 作动词是“重视”或“估价”。

senses.en: a person who follows Islam
of Muslims or Islam

ex.en: The museum explains how local Muslims mark the festival.
ex.zh: 博物馆讲解当地穆斯林如何过这个节日。

ex.en: A school calendar that names one holiday should also leave room for a Muslim student to be absent for another.
ex.zh: 只写一个节日的校历，也应当给穆斯林学生为另一个节日请假留出空间。

tip: Muslim 作名词和形容词都要大写。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a formal talk, or the power of speaking

ex.en: Her speech at the ceremony was three minutes.
ex.zh: 她在典礼上的演讲只有三分钟。

ex.en: A speech that names no fact can still sound confident, which is why the class checks sources.
ex.zh: 一篇不提事实的演讲仍可能听起来自信，所以班级要核来源。

tip: speech 表示一次演讲时可数。表示说话能力时不可数。

senses.en: a large area of water surrounded by land

ex.en: We are not allowed to swim in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们不准在湖里游泳。

ex.en: A clean lake supports birds and a town's drinking water at the same time.
ex.zh: 干净的湖同时养活鸟类和一座城镇的饮用水。

tip: lake 是被陆地包围的湖。sea 是海。

senses.en: to show a feeling or idea in words
a fast train or delivery
travelling or sent very fast

ex.en: She could not express the idea in one sentence.
ex.zh: 她没法用一句话表达这个想法。

ex.en: Students who express a worry early give the school time to change the plan.
ex.zh: 早点说出担心的学生，给学校留下改变计划的时间。

tip: express 作名词或形容词可指快车或特快。

senses.en: a level used for judging
usual or accepted

ex.en: The school raised its safety standard.
ex.zh: 学校提高了安全标准。

ex.en: A national standard for school buses helps only if villages can afford to meet it.
ex.zh: 校车的国家标准只有在乡村负担得起时才有帮助。

tip: standard 作形容词是“标准的”。

senses.en: to or at a distance

ex.en: She put the phone away during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭时她把手机收起来了。

ex.en: Moving factories away from rivers can protect drinking water for the towns downstream.
ex.zh: 把工厂迁离河流，可以保护下游城镇的饮用水。

tip: away 是副词，不单独接宾语；表示离开某地用 away from。

senses.en: inside a limit of time, distance, or area

ex.en: Please reply within three days.
ex.zh: 请在三天内回复。

ex.en: A clinic within walking distance saves families the cost of a long bus ride.
ex.zh: 步行能到的诊所，能为家庭省下长途公交的费用。

col: within reach｜在够得着的范围内
tip: within 强调不超过某个范围；in 更一般。

senses.en: to put a hand on something
an act of touching, or the sense

ex.en: Do not touch the wet paint on the door.
ex.zh: 别碰门上还没干的油漆。

ex.en: A museum that lets students touch a copy of an old tool teaches more than a glass case alone.
ex.zh: 让学生触摸一件古工具复制品的博物馆，比只有玻璃柜教得更多。

tip: keep in touch 表示保持联系，不是身体接触。

senses.en: the writer of a book or article

ex.en: The author of the article is a local teacher.
ex.zh: 这篇文章的作者是一位本地老师。

ex.en: An author who hides their name makes it harder to judge the facts.
ex.zh: 隐瞒姓名的作者让人更难判断事实。

tip: author 是可数名词。

senses.en: a country, or a people

ex.en: The nation celebrates this day in October.
ex.zh: 这个国家在十月庆祝这一天。

ex.en: A nation that funds rural schools changes who gets to sit a university exam.
ex.zh: 资助乡村学校的国家，会改变谁有机会参加大学考试。

tip: nation 强调人民或政治共同体。country 更常指国土。

senses.en: a device for speaking to someone at a distance

ex.en: I left my phone in the classroom.
ex.zh: 我把电话落在教室了。

ex.en: A phone warning about a storm helps only the people who still have power and a signal.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的手机警报，只帮助那些还有电和信号的人。

tip: phone 作动词是“打电话”：phone sb。

senses.en: to fail to catch, or to feel sad someone is away

ex.en: I missed the early bus this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我错过了早班车。

ex.en: Students miss more than a lesson when a flood closes the only road to school.
ex.zh: 当洪水封了唯一的上学路，学生错过的不只是一节课。

tip: Miss 大写是对未婚女性的称呼，和动词 miss 不同。

senses.en: to send something through the air with the hand

ex.en: Do not throw bags on the stairs.
ex.zh: 不要把包扔在楼梯上。

ex.en: Players who throw the ball too hard in a small hall break both windows and the game.
ex.zh: 在小礼堂里扔球太用力的人，既会打碎窗户，也会毁掉比赛。

tip: throw 的过去式是 threw，过去分词是 thrown。

senses.en: to go from one place to another
the activity of travelling

ex.en: We travel to school by bus.
ex.zh: 我们乘公交去上学。

ex.en: Waste can travel downstream farther than the factory that produced it.
ex.zh: 废物可以向下游流到比产生它的工厂更远的地方。

tip: travel 作名词“旅行”通常不可数。

senses.en: to come after, or to obey

ex.en: Follow the signs to the hall.
ex.zh: 按指示牌去大厅。

ex.en: Students follow a timetable, but the buses they need may follow a different one.
ex.zh: 学生遵守课表，但他们需要的公交可能遵守另一份时刻表。

tip: follow 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，通常不加 to。

senses.en: to make something clear

ex.en: Can you explain this sentence in English?
ex.zh: 你能用英语解释这个句子吗？

ex.en: Charts that explain a water shortage help a town argue for repairs before the next dry summer.
ex.zh: 解释缺水的图表，能帮助一座城镇在下一个干旱的夏天之前争取维修。

col: explain sth to sb｜向某人解释
tip: 说 explain something to somebody，不说 explain somebody something。
